title: Wait-Based Mileage Tolerance Schedule (Trade-In Agreements)
content:
The mileage tolerance allowed at a **Trade-In Agreements** pickup inspection depends on the wait between the offer and the pickup, counted in calendar days from the offer date shown on the agreement to its pickup date. The mileage overage found at inspection is measured against the mileage tolerance allowed.

| Wait from the offer date to the pickup date | Mileage tolerance allowed |
|---|---|
| Longer than 21 days | 2000 miles |
| Longer than 14 days, but not longer than 21 days | 1500 miles |
| 14 days or shorter | The grade's mileage tolerance; no longer-wait allowance |

## Boundaries

| Wait | Tolerance allowed |
|---|---|
| 14 days | The grade's mileage tolerance |
| 15 days | 1500 miles |
| 21 days | 1500 miles |
| 22 days | 2000 miles |

## Counting the wait

The wait is the number of calendar days from the offer date to the pickup date: an offer dated the 1st and a pickup on the 23rd of the same month is a wait of 22 days. Both dates are read from the trade-in agreement.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An agreement's offer is dated the 2nd and the vehicle is picked up on the 20th of the same month, a wait of 18 days. The overage at inspection is measured against 1500 miles: an overage of 1400 miles is within it, and an overage of 1600 miles is greater than it.
